versions.changelog:
Initial release of zhangye-it-bidding skill:

- Searches and collects current-month IT/informatization bidding announcements for Zhangye City from major government procurement platforms and search engines.
- Applies clear filtering criteria to include relevant IT/digital projects and exclude unrelated announcements.
- Automatically extracts key fields from valid announcements and appends entries into a predefined Excel template.
- Avoids duplicates by checking project name and code against existing records.
- Outputs summary statistics after each execution: platforms searched, announcements found, valid projects, new entries, and skipped (already recorded) items.
